intro.title: Finger numbers
intro.text: Your fingers are numbered 1 to 5: thumb is 1, pinky is 5. The small numbers above the notes tell you which finger to use.

intro.title: D, finger 2
intro.text: D is the white key between the two black keys.

intro.title: E, finger 3
intro.text: E is just right of the two black keys.
